[PROPOSED| ORDER
This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff's Motion for Referral to an Early Settlement
Conference (ECF No.
_ (the "Motion"'). Upon consideration of the Motion, the Memorandum
in Support, any response and reply, and the record, and for good cause shown, it is hereby
ORDERED as follows:
The Motion is GRANTED.
This action is REFERRED to United States Magistrate Judge
for a
settlement conference under Local Civil Rule 83.6.
3.
Plaintiff and counsel of record for Defendants shall participate in the settlement
conference and comply with the settlement judge's directions concerning scheduling, format,
required attendance, settlement authority, and any settlement submissions.
1

This Order does not stay the action, extend any deadline, or withdraw or modify
any pending motion, objection, or hearing request.
The Clerk's Office is directed to provide a copy of this Order to pro se Plaintiff at his last
known address.
Alexandria, Virginia
, 2026
Rossie D. Alston, Jr.
United States District Judge
